speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: asked the Minister for Transport whether mothers are allowed to breastfeed their children onboard public trains and buses.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: But as I shared with him, the SMRT website still says this today to an FAQ, "Can I breastfeed or feed my children?" And the reply is, "For the comfort of other passengers, it is best to feed your children before entering our stations." So, if it is not prohibited, then, could we not send the message to say that it is best not to do it?

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: Can I also just confirm that they are allowed to breastfeed their babies without a cover on?
